claims.text: OpenRouter's Aug 17 post launches the Activity dashboard (spend/requests/tokens/cache-hit/blended-cost views) with Explore/Trends/logs drill-downs.
The same surface is exposed via the Analytics API (meta + query endpoints) behind management keys, with an agent skill and cost-control cookbook.
